name: week
title: Practice week
subtitle: Read-only practice records. Appointment times are local to the practice.

sections.title: Appointments
sections.sql: select day,starts,minutes,patient,provider,location,status,reason from dental.day_book where day between current_date and current_date+7 order by day,starts

sections.title: Recalls
sections.sql: select patient,due_on,days_overdue,reason,next_booking,missed_visits from dental.recall_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Plans
sections.sql: select code,patient,title,status,age_days,fee_cents,currency,next_booking from dental.plan_followup order by age_days desc

sections.title: Overdue accounts
sections.sql: select code,patient,due_on,currency,balance_cents from dental.balances where balance_cents>0 and due_on<current_date order by due_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select rule,patient,issue,source from dental.compliance_gaps order by rule,patient
